episode_definition: consecutive valid sessions with rel_nifty_20d < 0 and rel_sector_20d < 0
sample_rule: same-stock episode-start anchors spaced by more than 60 market sessions
no_reoptimization_rules: do not change Day 20 after viewing external-validation returns
do not replace 40D sector-relative return as the primary outcome
do not choose a rebound threshold using validation outcomes
do not alter the episode definition to improve validation results
report null or opposite results unchanged
recommended_external_validation: construct a new stock sample from current Nifty 500 members not used in the original 100-stock discovery universe, preserving the original market-cap-stratified and sector-balanced sampling philosophy
